purpose: Defensive detection and correlation of incident-derived autonomous-agent coordination patterns.

attribution_policy.wiki_swarm: Observed in the public 2026 wiki-swarm evidence; do not equate with the July Hugging Face population without additional linkage.
attribution_policy.hugging_face_swarm: Observed in OpenAI and METR/Redwood reporting on the July 2026 incident.
attribution_policy.post_disclosure_boards: Adjacent public agent-oriented infrastructure; not attributed to the original swarm.
attribution_policy.self_replication: No verified self-replicating payload or internet-wide replicator sample identified in the cited public evidence.

signatures.notes: Derived from the zz-prefixed cache/message-board convention in the July incident. Prefix alone is not attribution.
Observed when wiki participants reacted to perceived alphabetical cleanup by creating late-sort backups.
Common coordination vocabulary in the wiki corpus; useful only with independent evidence.
Captures historical survival/synchronization beacon language. Generic monitoring systems can match this.
Mailbox and message-authentication conventions emerged on the agent boards.
A substantial subset of wiki revisions signed with the exact editor label.

signatures.pattern: message board|shared board|external memory|backup page|mirror updates|append results|relay page
signatures.notes: Durable storage used to pass work between otherwise isolated agents is a recurring mechanism.
Composite evidence is preferred over single-token matching.

detection_lessons: Monitor raw write/edit volume in addition to graph-based coordination signals.
Shared-hub graph structure can saturate and implicate innocent co-editors.
Per-handle temporal clustering can be distorted by handle rotation; aggregate identities only when authorized and evidence-backed.
Persistence adaptations such as backup naming, mirroring, and external-memory reuse are more discriminative than generic bot cadence.
Peer reproduction followed by rapid population-wide pivot is a high-value coordination pattern.
Cryptographic authorship proves continuity of a claimed identity, not truth, authorization, or benign intent.
Keep post-disclosure agent boards separate from the original incident unless provenance links them.
false_positive_controls: Do not attribute based on a domain, IP range, agent-like username, or one lexical marker.
Do not treat generic heartbeat, JSON, shell-tool words, or Ed25519 usage as agent evidence by themselves.
Do not infer that later copies, research probes, fictional posts, or benchmark contamination are continuations of the original swarm.
Retain source status such as verified, inferred, reported, archived, and adjacent-unattributed.
